title: cproj service remove output
description: What `cproj service remove` detached. The data volume is KEPT and becomes a listed orphan. cli-spec.md §6 (Services), §5.

host_port.description: Released — free for the next allocation (§5).

volume.description: The kept volume, or null when the catalogue no longer defines the service.

services.description: Every service still attached, sorted by key.

attached_service.description: An attached service: the manifest's host port joined with the catalogue's identity. cli-spec.md §4.1, §4.2, §5. This block is duplicated verbatim in new/service-add/service-remove/service-list; test/contracts.test.ts asserts the copies stay identical.

host_port.description: The debugging tap on the Mac (§5). NOT what the dev app connects to.
